principles.single_source_of_truth: Google Sheets audit ledger for operational events; GitHub for code; Notion for decisions and project knowledge; Drive for file snapshots.

integrations.free_policy: Use provider free tier only; monitor quotas and stop on quota/billing uncertainty.
Require model ID ending in :free unless paid use is explicitly enabled.
Disabled by default; never call unless ALLOW_PAID_AI=true.
Personal product access does not imply unlimited or free API usage.
App runtime requires a Notion integration token and page sharing.
Repository-scoped GitHub App; current app route is read-only.
Use project OIDC where supported; no paid feature or deployment action without owner approval.
Webhook secret and owner chat allowlist required.
Gemini Google Search grounding has usage-based billing beyond the current free allowance; keep disabled until quota and billing are explicitly checked.
